test_isocalendar_returns_correct_values_: test DatetimeIndex.isocalendar returns correct ISO year, week, and day values near new year with timezone
test_isocalendar_with_tz: test DatetimeIndex.isocalendar with Europe/Brussels timezone returns DataFrame with UInt32 year, week, day columns
test_dti_timestamp_isocalendar_fields: test DatetimeIndex.isocalendar fields match individual Timestamp.isocalendar for the same date
test_isocalendar_returns_dataframe: test DatetimeIndex.isocalendar returns a DataFrame with year, week, day columns indexed by the original dates
test_isocalendar_year_boundary: test DatetimeIndex.isocalendar correctly handles ISO week year boundaries across December and January
